item.title: Picture of the Day
item.description: Rabbi Velly Karp of Crown Heights was seen giving Mishloach Monos to David Seagal of the NYC Sanitation Dept. on Purim day. Photo

item.title: Community Joins Purim Bash in Crown Heights
item.description: The Crown Heights community joined for a grand Purim Bash featuring music and dancing, with performances by singing sensation Eli Marcus and the Chony Milecki band. Photos, Video

item.title: Megillah Read at the White House
item.description: Over 50 senior White House and Administration staff participated in a special Purim celebration at the White House, led by Rabbi Levi Shemtov, Executive Vice President of American Friends of Lubavitch (Chabad). Full Story, Photos, Video

item.title: Purim is Winding Down, Bochurim Need Your Ahavas Chassidim
item.description: Make your care and concern for the Bochurim (possibly your future son in law) part of this Purim. Full Story

item.title: Fred Kreizman Appointed NYPD Assistant Commissioner Community Affairs
item.description: Fred Kreizman, an Orthodox Jew who ran former Mayor Eric Adams’ community affairs unit, has been appointed NYPD Assistant Commissioner of Community Affairs. Full Story

item.title: NY Comptroller Hears the Megillah
item.description: Crown Heights leaders visited NYC's Jewish Comptroller Mark Levine’s office for Purim to celebrate and read the Megillah. Full Story

item.title: Live: 30 Letters in 30 Days
item.description: Live at 10:00 PM ET: Rabbi Shais Taub re-launches his annual “Thirty Letters in Thirty Days” live series, beginning Motzei Shabbos at 10 PM ET, as a 30-day preparation for the Rebbe’s birthday featuring nightly classes on letters from Volume 12 of Igros Kodesh. Live

item.title: Festive Purim on the Streets of Crown Heights
item.description: Rainy weather couldn't dampen the joyous Purim spirit in Crown Heights on Tuesday as many headed out in costume to deliver Mishloach Manos to family and friends. Photos
